Samantha —

Appreciate the clear asks. I put together a concise pilot proposal and a pricing workbook (attached). Key points:

- Pilot length: 6 weeks (30-day ingestion window + 30-day evaluation).
- Credit waterfall (pilot-only):
  * Onboarding credit: 100k trace-ingest units to validate baseline traffic (one-time).
  * Weekly buffer credits: 20k units/week to smooth spikes; unused buffer rolls into the next week for pilot only.
  * Overage rate during pilot: $0.012 per trace-ingest unit (discounted vs standard).
- Dashboard access: two advanced seats included (read/write for SRE owners). Additional seats priced at $250 seat/month pro-rated for pilot.
- Retention: live retention for 90 days included. Archive storage to object store at $0.006/GB/month if you elect >90 days.
- SLA/Support: pilot includes bronze SRE office hours and one on-call workshop.

I attached a one-page SOW and the workbook with a sample waterfall model using Ledger's approximate traffic numbers from the demo. If procurement needs line items split out (credits vs seat fees vs archive), I can produce a statement of fees.

Two quick asks from me:
1) Confirm the primary contact for technical onboarding (email + pager preferred).
2) Can procurement sign the SOW with a 30-day payment term for pilot?

If this looks good I'll loop legal for a short SOW and we can start onboarding the week after sign.

Best —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.ai

Attachments: pilot-pricing-workbook.xlsx, sow-draft-LL-2026.pdf

Subject: Fwd: Re: Evaluating observability for production traces + dashboards — proposed concession/ask

Looping you both for quick approval on a small concession request from Ledger Labs. Thread below.

Summary of my thinking:
- Request: They want a clear pilot waterfall and 90-day retention included. Fine.
- Concession ask from their side (via demo): procurement may push for a 20% pilot usage credit if we want to protect them from early overages.

I recommend we offer a structured concession:
- Give a 15% usage-credit on billed ingestion during pilot (applies only if they exceed onboarding + buffer credits).
- Keep overage $0.012/unit but cap cumulative overage exposure to $1,500 for pilot term (protects them, keeps our downside limited).
- Keep archive pricing as-is and include the two advanced seats as complimentary for pilot.

Why: This reduces their perceived risk and keeps billing simple. Marketing/customer success can get a short case study if pilot converts.

Questions for you:
- Marissa: ok to approve the 15% usage-credit and $1,500 overage cap?
- Ben: any commercial objections to including complimentary seats (2) during pilot?

I want to respond to Samantha today with the revised workbook if approved.

Thanks —
Diego
